test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If BREAK is coded as YIVZP, then how will MANGO be coded?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ef23e4e1d51f1d6fa6cc781e85a1def568fa4aad3a2f45c80bf311c66527165.png] 

Each letter is coded as the letter which have same positional value in reverse alphabetical order.

So, the code for BREAK will be

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d0bb963f04a235741969d0207804e20418b5d10c78043009eacf2b20c37c4a6.png] 

Similarly, the code for MANGO will be

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3702831928c7c835c9a8c563d30378d6f322cb8627803e96cd9bc6d4d339f9a3.png] 

Hence, 'MANGO' will be
 coded as 'NZMTL'.
